issue: A broad consumer can read the base output of a selected producer that executes later in the same invocation. Blanket candidate projection falsely rejected that valid snapshot.
resolution: After whole-output concurrency checks, each consumer independently selects a captured candidate generation or an exact captured base generation only while the branch producer output still equals base. Other inputs remain checked against latest branch.
telemetry_correction: RUNTIME_TELEMETRY.json and RUNTIME_PHASES.json supersede earlier token-unavailable statements while preserving them.

preserved_repeat_setup_failure.failure: Local temporary Git clone returned128 in setUp before the later-producer test body. No freshness assertion failed.
